rss_contract.normalization: directional centre separation / required centre separation - 1
rss_contract.aggregation: max over directions, min over ego-object pairs and recorded times
rss_contract.orientation: larger margin means safer; risk is negative margin
rss_contract.response_assumption: Intel fixed roles: evaluated ADS 1 s; every other object 2 s
rss_contract.lateral_stopping: only inward velocity after response; original paper buffer floor

costs.timing_scope: Summed per-run measurements, not parallel end-to-end elapsed time. RSS is not added again to replay wall time.

follow_source_export.scope: One repeat of selected follow prior inference and NPZ export, excluding model/archive loading; initial export was not separately timed. This does not replace its first elapsed time.

costs.source_timing_note: Initial expanded-cache export was not separately timed; a checked repeat is reported separately. Existing model construction costs remain in their original resource reports.

prediction.scope: Unqueried candidates after each method's own paid prefix; paths differ. Ranking hits are diagnostic, not additional discoveries.

negative_transfer_diagnosis.selection: every task with fewer final discoveries than its matched no-history control
negative_transfer_diagnosis.scope: Existing Random-prefix states at 20/50/100; target truth is used only for scoring. Components share the saved paid state and historical representation.

knowledge_archive_check.scope: Archive admission and one frozen-model source construction; no accumulation-effect experiment and no changes to running task snapshots.
